summary: After upgrading 2.4 to 2.6 with controller behind a load balancer, gateway connections can fail with 'Error connecting to Controller API'. On each controller host add the gateway URL to CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS in settings.py and run automation-controller-service restart.
questions: How do I fix 'Error connecting to Controller API' after upgrading to 2.6?
What is CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS used for in automation controller?
Why does the gateway fail to reach controller behind a load balancer?

answer_card.title: Fix 'Error connecting to Controller API' after upgrade
answer_card.answer_md:
Happens after 2.4 → 2.6 when controller sits behind a load balancer.

On every controller host, add the platform gateway URL to `settings.py`:
```python
CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS = ['https://appX.example.com:8443', 'https://www.example.com']
```
Then run `automation-controller-service restart` on each host.
